svg.title: Emphasis
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 6 panels. Panel 1. Caption: "shot = "close" (medium, close, extreme)". A man says: "A close shot for the line a face would carry." Panel 2. Caption: "inset = { on = "...", zoom = 2.4, marks = [...] }". Panel 3. Caption: "horizon = 0.42, depth = 0..1 (haze is automatic)". Panel 4. Caption: "spotlight = "..."" Panel 5. Caption: "burst = { on = "...", color = "gold" }, grade = "warm"". Panel 6. Caption: "look = "cold" | "warm" | "faded", grade = "cold"".
svg.text: the camera, depth, light and marks · utils/lib/comic.py
